description: Wiley Scholar Gateway enables ChatGPT to generate responses grounded in peer-reviewed sources with verifiable citations and DOI links. The Wiley Scholar Gateway Connector searches literature from Wiley journals to deliver evidence-backed answers with complete source metadata. This enables you to verify that claims are backed with sourced research — ensuring your research meets professional research standards.
